The corresponding wavelength is

\[
\lambda=\frac{hc}{E}
=\frac{1239.84\ \text{eV}\cdot\text{nm}}{2.3393\ \text{eV}}
\approx 530\ \text{nm}.
\]

A wavelength near \(530\ \text{nm}\) is green. Using the complementary-color relationship for dyes, green corresponds to absorption in the red region. Thus, among the choices, the absorbed light is red.

Answer: B
